shortDescription: Russia will run a budget deficit of 2.2% of gross domestic product next year, Finance Minister Anton Siluanov said on Thursday.Russia sees its budget spending in 2027 at 48.8 trillion roubles, Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin said.
